name: @asashiki/music-mcp
description: MCP server that lets AI drop a playable music player (Meting-compatible sources) right into the chat — search, single tracks, playlists, synced lyrics.

scripts.build:server: tsup src/server.ts src/stdio.ts --format esm --platform node --target node20 --out-dir dist --clean
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:widget
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test src/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.preview:player: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/player-preview.ts
